description: This file defines the Basket entity class in the ApplicationCore layer of the eShopOnWeb project. It implements core logic for managing shopping basket items, including adding items, removing empty items, and updating buyer information.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: Represents a shopping basket for a buyer, containing multiple basket items and associated operations.

methods.name: Basket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new basket with the specified buyer ID.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the basket or increases quantity if item already exists.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyItems
methods.description: Removes all items with a quantity of zero from the basket.

methods.name: SetNewBuyerId
methods.description: Updates the buyer ID associated with the basket.
